paite: Huchi in Jerubbaal, huai tuh Gideon ahi a, huan akiang a om mi tengteng zingkhang in athou ua, Harod tuikhuk chin ah akikulh uh. Midiante bel mallam pang Moreh mual bul phaizang ah akikulh uhi.
heading: Gideon In Midiante Azou
english: Then Jerubbaal, who is Gideon, and all the people who were with him, rose up early and encamped beside the spring of Harod. Midian’s camp was on the north side of them, by the hill of Moreh, in the valley.

paite: TOUPA'N Gideon kiang ah, "Na kiang a om mite, Midiante akhut ua ka piakna ding in atam lua uh. Huchi lou in zaw Israelte'n, 'Ei khut ngei a kihunkhia i hi uh,' chi in ahon otkhum kha ding uhi.
english: Yahweh said to Gideon, “The people who are with you are too many for me to give the Midianites into their hand, lest Israel brag against me, saying, ‘My own hand has saved me.’

paite: Huaiziak in ngai in, mite zak in, 'Kuapeuh lau leh ling a-omleh kik nawn henla,' Gilead tang a pan paikik nawn hen, chi in genkhia in," achi hi. Huchi in mite singnih-le-sangnih akik nawn ua; singkhat a-om lai uhi.
english: Now therefore proclaim in the ears of the people, saying, ‘Whoever is fearful and trembling, let him return and depart from Mount Gilead.’” So twenty-two thousand of the people returned, and ten thousand remained.

paite: TOUPA'N Gideon kiang ah, "Mite atam lo lai uh. Lui ah pisuk inla, huai ah ke'n ka hon khensak ding. Huan hichi ahi ding a, hiai mi zaw na kiang ah pai heh, ka chih peuhmah na kiang ah pai hen. Hiai mi zaw na kiang ah pai kei heh, ka chih peuhmah pai kei hen," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Gideon, “There are still too many people. Bring them down to the water, and I will test them for you there. It shall be, that those whom I tell you, ‘This shall go with you,’ shall go with you; and whoever I tell you, ‘This shall not go with you,’ shall not go.”

paite: Huchi in lui ah mite apisuk a, TOUPA'N Gideon kiang ah, "Ui bang a, alei a tui liahthoh peuhmah atuam in koih inla, huchi mah bang in kun a khukdin a tui hipthoh peuhmah leng," achi hi.
english: So he brought down the people to the water; and Yahweh said to Gideon, “Everyone who laps of the water with his tongue, like a dog laps, you shall set him by himself; likewise everyone who bows down on his knees to drink.”

paite: Akhutpek a liahthohte mi zathum ahi ua, midang tengteng kun a khukdin a tui hip vek ahi uh.
english: The number of those who lapped, putting their hand to their mouth, was three hundred men; but all the rest of the people bowed down on their knees to drink water.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA'N Gideon kiang ah, "Mi zathum, aliah a liahthohte zang in ka hon hunkhe ding. Midiante na khut ah ka hon pe ding hi. Mipi teng amau mun chiat ah pai nawn uhen," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Gideon, “I will save you by the three hundred men who lapped, and deliver the Midianites into your hand. Let all the other people go, each to his own place.”

paite: Huchi in mite'n nek ding leh apengkulte uh atawi ua; Israel mi tengteng apuanin lam uah apaisak vek a, mi zathumte ahihleh a-omsak a, Midiante kulh bel anuai phaizang a om ahi.
english: So the people took food in their hand, and their trumpets; and he sent all the rest of the men of Israel to their own tents, but retained the three hundred men; and the camp of Midian was beneath him in the valley.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, huai zan in TOUPA'N akiang ah, "Thou inla, kulh ah va hohsuk dih ve; na khut ah ka hon peta.
english: That same night, Yahweh said to him, “Arise, go down into the camp, for I have delivered it into your hand.

paite: Himahleh hohsuk na lauhleh na sikha Purah toh kulh ah va hohsuk phot un.
english: But if you are afraid to go down, go with Purah your servant down to the camp.

paite: Huchi in athugen uh na za dia; huai khit chiang in na khut hihhat in a-om dia, kulh ah na hoh ngamta ding,” achi hi. Huchi in asikha Purah toh kulh a galvengte tuah masakna pen omna ah ahohsuk uhi.
english: You will hear what they say; and afterward your hands will be strengthened to go down into the camp.” Then went he down with Purah his servant to the outermost part of the armed men who were in the camp.

paite: Midiante, Amalekte leh suahlam tapate tengteng huai phaizang ah khaupehon bang in tampi ana om ua; asangawngsaute uh sim seng vual louh, atamlam uh lah tuipi piau a piaunel zah mahmah ahi uhi.
english: The Midianites and the Amalekites and all the children of the east lay along in the valley like locusts for multitude; and their camels were without number, as the sand which is on the seashore for multitude.

paite: Gideon atunsuk in, ngai in, mi khat in alawmpa amang ana hilh a, akiang ah, "Ngai in, mang ka nei a, Midiante kulh ah barli buh tanghou phel ana om a, puanin ah ana tuklut a, ahon hihchim a, ahih lumlet a, puanin akiphah maimah," achi hi.
english: When Gideon had come, behold, there was a man telling a dream to his fellow. He said, “Behold, I dreamed a dream; and behold, a cake of barley bread tumbled into the camp of Midian, came to the tent, and struck it so that it fell, and turned it upside down, so that the tent lay flat.”

paite: Alawmpa'n adawng a, "Huai ahihleh Israel mi, Joash tapa Gideon namsau lou bangdang hi kei e. Pathian in Midiante leh sepaih tengteng akhut a pia ahita ve," achi hi.
english: His fellow answered, “This is nothing other than the sword of Gideon the son of Joash, a man of Israel. God has delivered Midian into his hand, with all the army.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Gideon in huai mang leh alehkhiakna akihilhchian uh azak in Pathian abeta hi. Huchi in Israelte kulh lam ah akik nawn a, "Thou dih uh; TOUPA'N Midian sepaihte na khut uah ahon peta hi," achi hi.
english: It was so, when Gideon heard the telling of the dream and its interpretation, that he worshiped. Then he returned into the camp of Israel and said, “Arise, for Yahweh has delivered the army of Midian into your hand!”

paite: Huchi in mi zathumte pawl thum in akhen a, avek un pengkul leh leibel vuak, asung a meisel koihsa ape chiat hi.
english: He divided the three hundred men into three companies, and he put into the hands of all of them trumpets and empty pitchers, with torches within the pitchers.

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Hon en unla, ka hih bang in hih sam un. Ngai un, kulh tuah masakpen ka tun chiang a ka hih bang a na hih sam ding uh ahi.
english: He said to them, “Watch me, and do likewise. Behold, when I come to the outermost part of the camp, it shall be that, as I do, so you shall do.

paite: Kei leh ka kiang a om tengteng in pengkul ka hon mut chiang un, kulh kimvel a om tengteng in pengkul na mut sam ding uhi, "TOUPA a ding leh Gideon a ding in' na chi chiat ding uh," achi hi.
english: When I blow the trumpet, I and all who are with me, then blow the trumpets also on every side of all the camp, and shout, ‘For Yahweh and for Gideon!’”

paite: Huchi in Gideon leh akiang a om mi zakhatte zanven laizang, galven akikhen kuan laitak in kulh tuah masak atungsuk ua, pengkul amut ua, aleibel tawi uh atatkham uhi.
english: So Gideon and the hundred men who were with him came to the outermost part of the camp in the beginning of the middle watch, when they had but newly set the watch. Then they blew the trumpets and broke in pieces the pitchers that were in their hands.

paite: Pawl thumte'n pengkul amut ua, leibelte atatkham ua, akhut veilam un meisel atawi ua, ataklam un pengkul mut ding atawi uhi. "TOUPA leh Gideon namsau," chi in akikou uhi.
english: The three companies blew the trumpets, broke the pitchers, and held the torches in their left hands and the trumpets in their right hands with which to blow; and they shouted, “The sword of Yahweh and of Gideon!”

paite: Kulh kim ah michih amau panmun chiat ah adingh vek ua; huchi in sepaih tengteng atai ua; akikou ua, ataizak uhi.
english: They each stood in his place around the camp, and all the army ran; and they shouted, and put them to flight.

paite: Mi zathumte'n pengkulte amut ua, TOUPA'N sepaih tengteng amau leh amau namsau in akisualsak a, huchi in sepaihte Zererah a Beth-shittah, Tabbath kiang a Abel-meholah gamgi pha in ataizak uhi.
english: They blew the three hundred trumpets, and Yahweh set every man’s sword against his fellow and against all the army; and the army fled as far as Beth Shittah toward Zererah, as far as the border of Abel Meholah, by Tabbath.

paite: Israelte Naphtali, Asher leh Manasseh tengteng a pan kigawmkhawm in Midiante anung-delhta uhi.
english: The men of Israel were gathered together out of Naphtali, out of Asher, and out of all Manasseh, and pursued Midian.

paite: Gideon in Ephraim tanggam tengteng ah, Midiante hong sual un, Beth-barah tan in luite na lakkhalh un, Jordan lui toh, chi in mite avialtaisak a, huchi in Ephraim tengteng akikhawm ua, Beth-barah tan in luite Jordan lui toh ana lakkhalh vek uhi.
english: Gideon sent messengers throughout all the hill country of Ephraim, saying, “Come down against Midian and take the waters before them as far as Beth Barah, even the Jordan!” So all the men of Ephraim were gathered together and took the waters as far as Beth Barah, even the Jordan.

paite: Midian kumpipa Oreb leh Zeeb aman ua; Oreb suangpi ah athat ua, Zeeb pen Zeeb grep sukna khuk ah athat uhi. Midiante adelhta ua, huchi in Oreb leh Zeeb lutang Jordan lui gal a Gideon kiang ah ahon tun uhi.
english: They took the two princes of Midian, Oreb and Zeeb. They killed Oreb at Oreb’s rock, and Zeeb they killed at Zeeb’s wine press, as they pursued Midian. Then they brought the heads of Oreb and Zeeb to Gideon beyond the Jordan.
